getting-started.title: Aniimo Beginner Guide: Launch Preparation
getting-started.description: Aniimo release dates, platforms and beginner launch checklist.
body: What is Aniimo?
Aniimo is a free-to-play, next-generation creature-catching open-world RPG set on the continent of Idyll. Players catch creatures, Twine with them, and explore by gliding, diving and burrowing.
Launch dates
PC and console launch on September 16, 2026. Mobile launches on September 23, 2026.
Before you start
Pre-register through the official site, choose your launch platform, and treat closed-beta values as provisional until the release build is tested.

core-gameplay.title: Aniimo Gameplay: Catching, Twine & Exploration
core-gameplay.description: Learn the confirmed core gameplay systems in Aniimo.
body: Catch and train
Meet and catch Aniimo throughout the open world, then train them for combat and exploration.
Twine
Twine lets the player merge with an Aniimo and use a different perspective or ability to move through the world.
Explore together
Official material highlights gliding, diving, burrowing, challenges, racing, solo play and multiplayer exploration.

download-preload.title: Aniimo Download & Preload Guide for PC, Console and Mobile
download-preload.description: Where to download Aniimo and what is officially confirmed about preload on Steam, Epic, PS5, Xbox, iOS and Android.
body: Where to download Aniimo
Use the platform links on the official Aniimo website for Steam, Epic Games, PlayStation 5, Xbox, App Store, and Google Play. Avoid unofficial APK, launcher, or key-download sites.
Is release preload available?

As checked on August 29, Pawprint Studio has not published a global-launch preload timetable. The July beta had a separate pre-download guide, but its dates and client do not confirm the release preload schedule.
PlayStation pre-order packs are not preload

PlayStation currently sells optional Advanced and Collector’s pre-order packs. The store states that the base game becomes free at launch; buying a reward pack does not prove that the release client can already be preloaded.
PC preparation
Steam lists 45 GB of available storage. Keep extra space for unpacking and patches, update GPU drivers, and sign in to the store account you plan to use before launch.
Console and mobile preparation
Enable automatic updates and verify free space on your device. Store pages can roll out at different times by region, so use the official listing rather than a search advertisement.
What we will update
This page will be updated when official preload times, launcher instructions, download sizes, and launch-day patch details are announced.

server-launch-times.title: Aniimo Server Launch Time by Region
server-launch-times.description: Aniimo global launch dates and the currently confirmed server-opening time converted for major regions.
server-launch-times.h1: Aniimo Server Launch Time by Region
body: Confirmed launch time

The official PlayStation listing states that the PS5 free-to-play launch begins September 16, 2026 at 10:00 UTC+8. Pawprint Studio separately confirms September 16 for PC and consoles and September 23 for mobile, but has not separately published an exact Steam or Xbox server-opening hour.
Regional conversion
10:00 UTC+8 equals 02:00 UTC, 03:00 BST, 04:00 CEST, 22:00 EDT on September 15, and 19:00 PDT on September 15. Daylight-saving rules can change, so confirm your local store countdown.
Mobile launch time
September 23 is confirmed for mobile, but a precise global server-opening hour has not been published. Do not assume it uses the same 10:00 UTC+8 time until Pawprint Studio confirms it.
Steam date difference

Steam currently displays September 15, while Pawprint Studio’s global announcement uses September 16. This is consistent with the PlayStation time falling on September 15 in the Americas, but use the live platform countdown rather than assuming every platform unlocks simultaneously.
Server regions
Beta notices used APAC, Europe, and America schedules, but final launch server names, maintenance windows, and character-transfer rules remain unconfirmed.

crossplay-cross-save.title: Aniimo Crossplay & Cross-Save Support Explained
crossplay-cross-save.description: What is confirmed about Aniimo cross-platform multiplayer, and what remains unknown about cross-save and account linking.
body: Crossplay is officially listed
Steam lists Cross-Platform Multiplayer alongside online co-op and online PvP. This supports play between more than one platform, although the exact platform combinations are not yet documented.
Cross-save is not confirmed
Pawprint Studio has not published final cross-progression rules. Crossplay does not automatically mean that saves, purchases, or characters transfer between PC, console, and mobile.
Account linking questions
The official site uses account-based registration, but launch rules for linking Steam, Epic, PlayStation, Xbox, Apple, and Google identities are still pending.
Purchases and regional servers
Premium currency, platform-exclusive items, server regions, and friend lists may have platform restrictions. Wait for the launch FAQ before purchasing with the expectation of transfer.
Safe launch approach
Choose one primary platform, use the same recoverable email where possible, and avoid creating duplicate characters until official linking instructions are available.

steam-deck.title: Does Aniimo Work on Steam Deck? Compatibility Status
steam-deck.description: Aniimo Steam Deck support is not yet verified. Compare the official PC requirements and current compatibility status.
body: No official Steam Deck rating yet
Aniimo has not been marked Steam Deck Verified or Playable on its Steam store page. Pawprint Studio has not announced a dedicated handheld mode.
Why compatibility is uncertain

The minimum specification lists Windows 10, 12 GB RAM, an i7-9700 or Ryzen 5 3600X, and GTX 1060 or RX 6600-class graphics. These desktop requirements cannot be translated directly into guaranteed Deck performance.
Linux and anti-cheat
SteamOS compatibility can depend on Proton, launcher behavior, account services, codecs, and anti-cheat. Those details have not been confirmed for the release build.
Possible alternatives
Aniimo is planned for GeForce NOW at launch, according to an official NVIDIA feature announcement. Cloud streaming may be an option on supported handheld devices and networks.
Testing plan
After release we will test installation, login, controls, text size, frame pacing, battery use, suspend/resume, and online modes before assigning a recommendation.
sources: Official NVIDIA and GeForce NOW announcement

languages-voice-acting.title: Aniimo Supported Languages & Voice Acting
languages-voice-acting.description: Aniimo language support on Steam, including interface, subtitles and currently listed full-audio languages.
body: Thirteen Steam languages

Steam currently lists English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, French, German, Russian, Indonesian, Thai, Brazilian Portuguese, Latin American Spanish, and Vietnamese interface and subtitle support.
Full audio languages
The current Steam table marks full audio for English and Korean. Japanese is listed for interface and subtitles but not full audio. Store information can change before release.
Text and subtitle support
All thirteen listed languages currently have interface and subtitle check marks, making them the safest confirmed localization set for the PC release.
Console and mobile differences
Language packs and voice options may differ by platform or region. Check the local store listing before downloading if a specific language is essential.
Post-launch updates
We will verify language selection, downloadable voice packs, subtitle sizing, dubbing credits, and whether voice settings can be changed without reinstalling.

egg-heist.title: Aniimo Egg Heist Guide: PvEvP Mode Explained
egg-heist.description: How Operation: Egg Heist worked in the Aniimo beta, including teams, Lost Isles objectives, combat and launch caveats.
body: What Egg Heist is

Operation: Egg Heist is a PvEvP activity set in the Lost Isles. Official beta notes describe gathering supplies, entering a forbidden area, fighting other Pathfinders, and competing for a Giant Darkler Egg.
Team size and access
Official store text describes a three-player team. Beta patch notes required Veteran Pathfinder rank, but that unlock condition may change for the global release.
PvE and PvP choices

A beta announcement said players could explore and gather supplies or fight other teams. This suggests risk-versus-reward decisions rather than continuous forced combat, but final rules need release testing.
Beta-only details
Darkler-form rewards, matchmaking behavior, transport protection, scoring, extraction, and untwine fixes appeared in beta updates. None should be assumed unchanged at launch.
Launch guide plan
The release-tested version will cover objectives, map flow, team roles, loadouts, reward tables, loss conditions, matchmaking, and efficient routes.

elements-roles.title: Aniimo Elements & Roles Explained
elements-roles.description: Official Aniimo elements, combat roles and beta type-counter information explained without speculative rankings.
body: Nine official index elements
The official Wiki currently filters Aniimo by holy, fire, ice, dark, electric, grass, water, rock, and wind.
Five listed roles
The same index lists DPS, Heal, Support, BREAK, and REGEN. A creature may contribute through damage, survival, control, recovery, or breaking enemy defenses rather than raw attack alone.
Counters in beta
An official beta handbook mentioned fire, water, grass, and lightning counters and recommended a balanced roster for Alpha battles. The complete release matchup chart has not been published.
Dual-element and form changes
Official entries can show more than one element or different forms. Nimbi, for example, is listed with wind and electric variants, so one name does not always describe a single combat profile.
Building teams responsibly
Do not treat a role filter as a tier ranking. Release testing must account for skills, traits, forms, enemy weaknesses, stamina, and team synergy.

evolution-forms.title: Aniimo Evolution & Forms Explained
evolution-forms.description: How Aniimo evolution stages, branching evolution and alternate forms are presented in official Wiki and beta information.
body: Official stages
The official Wiki filters entries by Lumin, Gamma, and Nova stages. Individual evolution lines can contain multiple numbered creatures or more than one Nova outcome.
Branching evolution

Official beta material describes multi-branch evolution. A beta update also noted that Fenrier could unlock the option to evolve into Glynsera at level 29, showing that evolution can involve conditions and player choice.
Forms are not always evolutions
Official entries may list Basic, habitat-related, weather-related, or other forms. Forms can change element, appearance, skills, or movement without necessarily becoming a different index number.
Special form terms

Official beta notices mention Prismana, Darkler, Sparkling, Alpha, weather forms, and other variants. Availability and preservation rules differed across events and should not be generalized to launch.
What the database will record
After release we will separate species ID, evolution stage, form ID, unlock condition, element, skills, habitat, and version so forms are not mistaken for entirely separate species.

release-date-platforms.title: Aniimo Release Date, Time & Platforms
release-date-platforms.description: Aniimo launches on PC and consoles September 16, 2026, followed by mobile September 23. See confirmed platforms and timing notes.
body: Official global release dates
Pawprint Studio announced September 16, 2026 for PC and consoles, followed by September 23 for iOS and Android. The PlayStation listing specifies 10:00 UTC+8 on September 16.
Confirmed platforms
The official site lists PlayStation 5, Xbox, Steam, Epic Games Store, App Store, and Google Play. No PlayStation 4, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch, or Mac version has been officially announced.
Why Steam may show September 15

Steam currently displays September 15 in some regions. This is consistent with a September 16 launch in UTC+8 appearing on the previous calendar day in western time zones; follow the store countdown for your local unlock.
Cross-platform support
Steam lists cross-platform multiplayer alongside single-player, online co-op, and online PvP. Final account-linking and cross-progression rules should be confirmed at launch.
Release checklist
Wishlist or pre-register on your preferred platform, reserve at least 45 GB on PC, and check the official news page for preload and server-opening notices.

pre-registration.title: Aniimo Pre-Registration Guide & Rewards
pre-registration.description: How to pre-register for Aniimo on PC, console and mobile, plus confirmed global milestone rewards.
body: Where to pre-register
Start from the official Aniimo website and choose PS5, Xbox, Steam, Epic Games, App Store, or Google Play. Store availability can vary by country, so use the platform button shown for your region.
Official milestone rewards

The official campaign lists Glimmer ×200 at 10 million registrations, Aniipod Ultra ×2 at 15 million, the limited Companion Promise avatar frame at 20 million, and the Sunlit Meadow limited outfit at 30 million.
Website registration and store wishlists

A website registration, store wishlist, mobile pre-order, and console pre-order are not necessarily the same action. Complete the official account registration and then follow the relevant store page for the platform you intend to use.
Avoid account mismatch
Use an email and login method you can access at launch. Time-limited web events may require the event email to match the account used to create the first in-game character.
Paid PlayStation packs
Aniimo's base game is free. PlayStation may sell optional pre-order packs containing cosmetics or a Companion Handbook; buying a pack is not required to play.

system-requirements.title: Aniimo PC System Requirements: Minimum & Recommended
system-requirements.description: Official Aniimo PC requirements covering Windows, CPU, GPU, RAM, DirectX, internet and storage.
body: Minimum PC requirements
64-bit Windows 10; Intel Core i7-9700 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600X; 12 GB RAM; NVIDIA GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 6600; DirectX 11; broadband internet; and 45 GB of available storage.
Recommended PC requirements
64-bit Windows 10 or newer; Intel Core i7-12700F or AMD Ryzen 7 7700X; 16 GB RAM; NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 8 GB or AMD Radeon RX 6800; DirectX 11; broadband internet; and 45 GB available storage.
Storage planning
The store lists 45 GB available space. Keep additional free space for unpacking, shader caches, patches, and screenshots rather than filling the drive to its limit.
Laptop and handheld notes
Mobile GPU names do not map directly to desktop cards. Steam Deck and other handheld compatibility have not been officially confirmed, so wait for launch-version testing before assuming support.
Internet requirement
Steam requires broadband internet and lists online interaction. Even if you focus on solo play, plan for downloads, account services, and online checks.

free-to-play.title: Is Aniimo Free to Play? Price & Purchases Explained
free-to-play.description: Aniimo is a free-to-play game with optional in-game purchases. Learn what is confirmed before launch.
body: Yes, the base game is free
Pawprint Studio and the official store listings describe Aniimo as free to play. The base client does not require a standard purchase price.
Optional purchases are confirmed
Steam and PlayStation both disclose optional in-game purchases. PlayStation also lists paid pre-order packs with cosmetics and Companion Handbook items.
What has not been fully detailed
Final prices, regional currencies, battle-pass cadence, premium currency rates, and the complete shop catalogue have not yet been published. Closed-beta values should not be treated as final.
Can you play without buying a pack?
Yes. PlayStation's store notice explicitly says the base game is available at no cost. Pre-order packs are optional extras, not an entry fee.
Our review standard
After launch we will separate cosmetic purchases, progression items, passes, and convenience features, then evaluate value without presenting spending as required.

confirmed-aniimo.title: Confirmed Aniimo List: Official Creatures Revealed
confirmed-aniimo.description: A verified overview of officially revealed Aniimo, including Emberpup, Celestis, Nimbi, Bolty and evolution lines.
body: The official index is live
The official Aniimo Wiki currently lists more than 90 numbered entries. These are confirmed creatures rather than names inferred from leaks or fan art.
Early official examples
Emberpup begins the official index at No.001, followed by Flameruff, Scorchhowl, and Inferlupa. Celestis and Stellarys appear at No.005–006, while Nimbi is No.018 and Bolty is No.048.
Elements and roles
The official index filters creatures by elements including holy, fire, ice, dark, electric, grass, water, rock, and wind, plus roles such as DPS, Heal, Support, Break, and Regen.
Forms and evolution

Official entries can include stages, alternate forms, habitats, mobility, traits, and skills. For example, Emberpup has multiple forms and an evolution line, while Nimbi is presented as a wind/electric support Aniimo.
Why this is not a tier list
Confirmation does not establish strength. Stats and skills can change before or after launch, so rankings will remain separate and noindex until repeatable release-version testing is complete.

catching-twine.title: Aniimo Catching & Twine System Explained
catching-twine.description: How catching, Aniipods, traps, creature forms and the Twine transformation system work in Aniimo.
body: How catching works
Official descriptions say Pathfinders catch Aniimo with Aniipods, can set traps, and need to time the catch. Exact capture-rate formulas and item modifiers should be verified in the release build.
Spawns respond to the world
Aniimo can appear according to environment, weather, phenomena, and time of day. A useful location guide therefore needs more than a single coordinate: it should record conditions and version.
What Twine means
Twine lets a Pathfinder become a collected Aniimo and use that creature's skills and perspective. It supports combat, puzzle solving, traversal, and environmental challenges.
Traversal examples

Official material specifically shows gliding, diving, and burrowing. Individual official Wiki entries also list mobility or pathfinding abilities, such as Emberpup's faster movement and Nimbi's aerial dash.
What we will verify at launch
We will test catch timing, trap behavior, failed-catch costs, form availability, stamina, cooldowns, and whether multiplayer changes capture ownership.

multiplayer.title: Aniimo Multiplayer, Co-op, PvP & Cross-Platform Guide
multiplayer.description: Confirmed Aniimo multiplayer features including online co-op, PvP, cross-platform play, camps and three-player Egg Heist.
body: Confirmed online modes
Steam lists single-player, online co-op, online PvP, and cross-platform multiplayer. The store also discloses in-game chat and online interaction.
Three-player Egg Heist
Egg Heist is described as a PvEvP mode in the Lost Isles. Players join a three-person team, search for supplies or objectives, fight in real time, and compete around a Giant Darkler Egg.
Open-world social spaces
Each Pathfinder has a personal RV at a campsite where players can meet and interact. Homeland activities include planting crops, building decorations, and arranging a personal space with Aniimo.
Solo play remains supported
Official descriptions explicitly mention solo and multiplayer play. That does not yet confirm which story activities allow drop-in co-op or how world progress is credited to guests.
Cross-progression is still unclear
Cross-platform multiplayer is listed, but final cross-save, account linking, regional server, friend-limit, voice-chat, and platform-subscription requirements need launch confirmation.
sources: Aniimo Steam features and multiplayer description

regions-world.title: Aniimo Regions & World Guide: The Continent of Idyll
regions-world.description: Explore the six officially revealed Aniimo regions across Idyll, including forests, coasts, flower fields and cloud grasslands.
body: The continent of Idyll
Aniimo takes place across Idyll, an open world designed around catching, Twine abilities, traversal, challenges, races, discovery, and social camps.
Forest of Falling Stars and Mistwoods
Forest of Falling Stars is a dense purple forest where Celestises glide among starine trees. Mistwoods is a poisonous swamp forest where glowing fruit helps guide travelers.
Echoback Landing and Sea of Flowers
Echoback Landing centers on an enormous stranded Aniimo and the mystery of its song. Sea of Flowers surrounds a perfume-making village with vast purple flower fields.
Blitzwood and Nimbus Fields
Blitzwood is scarred by lightning drawn to Bolties and filled with thunder-struck trees. Nimbus Fields places low clouds over broad grasslands where Nimbis bounce across the terrain.
How the map will expand
The current guide covers only officially named regions. Coordinates, resource nodes, quests, fast-travel points, weather cycles, and spawn tables will be added after in-game verification.

editorial-policy.title: Data, Version & Correction Policy
editorial-policy.description: How Aniimo Guide verifies sources, versions and corrections.
body: Source labels
Official information, repeatable testing, community reports and speculation are kept clearly separate.
Version control
Stats, drops, shops, capture rates and quest conditions include a game version and last verification date.
Corrections
Confirmed errors are corrected promptly. Beta data is never assumed to remain unchanged at launch.

falling-stars: A purple forest where Celestises glide among starine trees.
mistwoods: A swampy forest of poisonous miasma, with glimmer fruits guiding lost travelers.
echoback: A vast Aniimo lies stranded on the shore; the answer may be hidden in its song.
flowers: Purple flower fields surround a perfume-making village that lives alongside Aniimo.
blitzwood: Lightning drawn by Bolties scars the earth and crackles through thunder-struck trees.
nimbus: Low clouds touch the grassland while Nimbis bounce across the open fields.
